note: Campground at Mars Vista operated by American Prairie (private nonprofit reserve), off US-191 between mileposts 96-97, ~7 mi north of the Missouri River near Zortman in the Little Rocky Mountains area. RV sites fit a Class A plus a vehicle; also 4 rental cabins and drive-in/walk-in tent platforms. Certified dark-sky site. --Claude
summary: American Prairie's own page confirms $39 RV sites, 30/50-amp at every RV site, pull-throughs, potable water, showers, Wi-Fi, reservable; added Hipcamp as the booking platform, 14-day max, and the (2025-dated) season May 23 - Oct 26. Not stated: site count (12) and the 45-ft figure (derived, left; the page says 'can fit a Class A motorhome plus a vehicle'). Note trimmed of restated values.
